majority.description: Always predict the majority training class (no lost time); accuracy equals 1 - prevalence.

all_positive.description: Review every case; recall 1, specificity 0; its cost per 1,000 cases is the floor to beat.

rule_not_cut_or_dust.description: Flag unless the nature of injury is a cut (180), dust in the eyes (320) or a scratch (310).

lookup_nature_bodypart_coal.description: Training lost-time rate of the nature x body part x sector cell, with coarser fall-backs.
